extName.message: BiliTitleFilter - Video & Promo Blocker for Bilibili
extName.description: Extension name (shown in the browser toolbar and on the add-ons store)

extDesc.message: Block Bilibili videos by your own title keywords: either mask them (cover and title merged into one notice, hover to peek) or hide them completely. Also includes an uploader whitelist (uploaders on it are never blocked) and per-category blocking for 18 kinds of promoted content such as live streams, anime, Chinese animation, variety shows and movies, plus a separate switch for the home-page carousel.
